heading: Monday Night
text: Becoming mostly cloudy north. Thickening high clouds south. Lows in the 40s. Winds light and variable east, and southwest near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west, diminishing overnight.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly cloudy from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north, with a rising chance of showers midday and afternoon through Quebec, south into the Adirondacks and northern Greens. Clouds and some filtered sun south. Continued warm. Highs in the 60s, closer to 60 northeast. Light winds becoming south to southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy, with some breaks south of Rt. 4. Clouds and scattered showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north, tapering off overnight. Lows in the 40s from the Green Mountains east, in the low 50s west. Winds south to southwest near 10 mph, becoming light in wind-sheltered valleys.
